backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping product features to frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styles defining design tokens and dark mode theming.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with SEO metadata and GA4 tracking scripts.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app assembling all sections, services, HOT PICK logic, and analytics initialization.
frontend/src/components/BusinessHighligh: Grid component showing location, hours, call, and WhatsApp info as clickable items.
frontend/src/components/HotBadge.tsx: Empty file with no component content.
frontend/src/components/HotFab.tsx: Floating action button labeled HOT PICK that triggers a scroll callback.
frontend/src/components/HotPickSection.t: Bottom-page HOT PICK section showing Motorola phone details, highlights, and enquiry actions.
frontend/src/components/MobileCareSmartU: Displays a list of smartphone care tips with a modal to show all facts.
frontend/src/components/SafeImage.tsx: Renders an image with error handling and fallback UI for failed loads.
frontend/src/components/TickerBanner.tsx: Creates a horizontally scrolling ticker banner with repeated text.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppQuickMes: Provides a popover button offering preset WhatsApp messages linked to a given number.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and refreshes a backend actor based on Internet Identity using react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, state, and login flow via a React context provider.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, color variables, utilities, and animations including a ticker and pulse effect.
frontend/src/lib/analyticsConfig.ts: Centralizes analytics configuration for GTM and GA4 using environment variables.
frontend/src/lib/assetVersion.ts: Provides a version constant and helper to append cache-busting query strings to asset URLs.
frontend/src/lib/clickTracking.ts: Implements delegated click tracking for WhatsApp and tel links, sending GA4 events.
frontend/src/lib/ga4.ts: Wraps GA4 event and page view tracking with safety checks to prevent errors when GA is unavailable.
frontend/src/lib/googleTracking.ts: Initializes GTM safely and provides a no‑op GA initializer, plus a combined tracking init function.
frontend/src/lib/scrollDepthTracking.ts: Tracks scroll depth at key thresholds and sends GA4 events using throttled scroll listeners.
frontend/src/lib/spaPageViews.ts: Patches history methods and listens to popstate to send GA4 page_view events in an SPA.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Describes HOT PICK feature requirements, constraints, analytics events, and image specifications for the landing page update.
